gloss: to peel off; to tear off; to strip

definitions.gloss: to peel off; to tear off
definitions.explanation: To remove something that is stuck or attached to a surface.
To take off a layer or coating from something.

examples.japanese: {壁紙|かべがみ}を{剥|は}がすのは{大変|たいへん}だった。
{彼|かれ}の{仮面|かめん}を{剥|は}がしてやった。

notes:
{剥|は}がす is a transitive verb ({他動詞|たどうし}). The intransitive pair is {剥|は}がれる (to come off, to peel off).

ASPECT ({ている}):
The ている form indicates ongoing action ({今|いま}シールを{剥|は}がしている = 'is peeling off the sticker now').

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [object]を{剥|は}がす (peel/tear off ~)
- [surface]から{剥|は}がす (peel off from ~)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- シールを{剥|は}がす (peel off a sticker)
- {壁紙|かべがみ}を{剥|は}がす (strip wallpaper)
- {皮|かわ}を{剥|は}がす (peel off skin/bark)
- {仮面|かめん}を{剥|は}がす (unmask; expose someone)
